crossRefs.note: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and…
“You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’
You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet…
He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded…
For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see king Solomon, with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day…
But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with…
His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one…
He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his…
In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai…
Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua, the son…
Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you…

people.name: Jehozadak
people.line: Father of Joshua the high priest during the exile.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: High priest during the rebuilding of the temple

translations.web: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
translations.bsb: Take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.
translations.kjv: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
translations.asv: yea, take of them silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
